name: Shimada Kai
source:
Member of the Wathc and the Shinsengumi's Corporal.
He observes the Shinsengumi members along with getting intel. He also serves as the Corporal of the 2th Division. He is the biggest man in the division and is very powerful.

[Taken from [url=http://ideafintl.com/hakuoki-kyoto/home.php]official english site[/url]]
